date.as_written: grahāṣṭajīmūtayute śakābde taiṣe site tārakajitsu tithyāṃ || saumyaidine

notes: Chronogram: graha = 9 and aṣṭa = 8. Read right to left, these give the last two digits, 89. 'jīmūta' (cloud) is not a standard number word. It must stand for 16 to give the catalogue's ŚS 1689, so the year depends on the catalogue and is uncertain. Pauṣa śukla 6 of ŚS 1689 falls around Dec 1767/Jan 1768. The scribe's name 'bhuvanādinanda' is taken as a metrical form of Bhuvanānanda, as the catalogue reads it. A literal reading, Bhuvanādinanda, is also possible. The colophon is metrically and grammatically loose ('jagāmaḥ', 'yaḥ').
